sents.t: In May, I’m going to have my first vacation in America, a whole week!
Lily and I decided to take a road trip to Rocky Mountain National Park in Colorado.
It’s about a fourteen-hour drive from Oakville.
Last night, we made a plan.
“We’re going to leave on Saturday at six in the morning,” Lily said.
“We’ll drive for eight hours and stay at a motel in Nebraska. On Sunday, we’ll arrive in the mountains.”
“Where are we going to sleep in the park?” I asked.
“At a campground. I’ve already reserved a site for four nights. It’s the cheapest way, and the most beautiful!”
Then we made a packing list: a tent, sleeping bags, warm clothes, hiking boots, sunscreen, and lots of snacks.
Lily is the most organized person I know.
She even made a playlist for the car.
Gas will cost about two hundred dollars, the motel will be ninety, and the park pass is thirty-five.
